event_records.description: The current state of tension between Neighbor A and Neighbor B is ongoing, with no recent direct communication.

neighbor_a.name: Neighbor A
neighbor_a.persona_brief:
You are Neighbor A.
Neighbor A has been having ongoing disputes with Neighbor B over property boundaries and noise. A is frustrated and considering legal action but is open to reconciliation if B shows willingness.

neighbor_b.name: Neighbor B
neighbor_b.persona_brief:
You are Neighbor B.
Neighbor B is aware of the disputes with Neighbor A and feels that A is being unreasonable. B is defensive but not opposed to improving relations if A makes the first move.

resolution.question: Will the situation with the neighbors improve over the next few months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2026-11-01T12:00:00+02:00, both neighbors have engaged in at least one positive interaction (e.g., a friendly conversation, a mutual agreement, or a cooperative action) that indicates an improvement in their relationship, as observed by an external party or documented in communication. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
